summary: PAID LIFT MVP tested end-to-end (backend + mobile web preview). Backend 19/19 pytest cases PASS (100%). Frontend: full onboarding→search→ride details→booking→wallet topup→profile→admin flow works. Aadhaar-verified badge, seeded Mumbai→Pune ride, booking PENDING state, ₹500 wallet topup + transaction list, and 4-tab admin panel with real seeded counts (8 users, 5 vehicles, 6 rides, 3 bookings) all verified. Minor deprecation warnings for shadow* style props and props.pointerEvents from RN web (non-blocking). No React Native red screens. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) in use.

ui_bugs.issue: Bottom tab bar items have no testID (used text-based selectors as workaround). Add testID via tabBarButton or wrapper.
Navigating directly to /home in a fresh browser session (no persisted user) shows 'Namaste, Traveler' rather than redirecting to onboarding. Add auth-guard/redirect when user context is missing.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props deprecated. Migrate to boxShadow for RN web compatibility.
Deprecation warning: props.pointerEvents deprecated. Move to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: (LOW) Add testID to bottom tab bar buttons (tab-home, tab-rides, tab-wallet, tab-profile) in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx for reliable test automation.
(MEDIUM) Add auth-guard on (tabs)/home so anonymous visits to /home redirect to '/' or /onboarding rather than showing 'Namaste, Traveler' with disabled features.
(LOW) Replace deprecated RN web style props: shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py excludes MongoDB _id via PROJECT = {_id: 0} — good.
Wallet paid flow: passenger debited full price, owner credited 90% (owner_amt), commission -10% recorded separately as wallet_txn — matches spec.
Rides search enriched with owner + vehicle in a per-doc loop (N+1). Fine for MVP scale but worth batching later.
server.py is a single ~575-line file — approaching 700-line threshold; consider splitting routers by resource before more features are added.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested critical flows (onboarding, search, booking, wallet, profile, admin)

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds on startup (4 rides across Mumbai→Pune, Delhi→Jaipur, Ahmedabad→Vadodara, Bengaluru→Mysuru). Verified present via /api/rides. No manual seed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_paidlift_api.py (reuse). BASE URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. OTP=123456 always. Aadhaar=any 12 digits. For frontend flows use mobile viewport 390x844 and drive onboarding in one session (AsyncStorage is fresh per browser context). Tab bar buttons currently lack testIDs — use text=Wallet/Profile/etc as last-resort selector.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only minor deprecation warnings from RN web and missing testIDs on tab bar.
